001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.combat;
002
003import java.awt.Color;
004
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.MutableShipStatsAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.combat.ShipAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Stats;
009
010public class TemporalShellStats extends BaseShipSystemScript {
011        public static final float MAX_TIME_MULT = 3f;
012        public static final float MIN_TIME_MULT = 0.1f;
013        public static final float DAM_MULT = 0.1f;
014        
015        public static final Color JITTER_COLOR = new Color(90,165,255,55);
016        public static final Color JITTER_UNDER_COLOR = new Color(90,165,255,155);
017
018        
019        public void apply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id, State state, float effectLevel) {
020                ShipAPI ship = null;
021                boolean player = false;
022                if (stats.getEntity() instanceof ShipAPI) {
023                        ship = (ShipAPI) stats.getEntity();
024                        player = ship == Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip();
025                        id = id + "_" + ship.getId();
026                } else {
027                        return;
028                }
029                
030                float jitterLevel = effectLevel;
031                float jitterRangeBonus = 0;
032                float maxRangeBonus = 10f;
033                if (state == State.IN) {
034                        jitterLevel = effectLevel / (1f / ship.getSystem().getChargeUpDur());
035                        if (jitterLevel > 1) {
036                                jitterLevel = 1f;
037                        }
038                        jitterRangeBonus = jitterLevel * maxRangeBonus;
039                } else if (state == State.ACTIVE) {
040                        jitterLevel = 1f;
041                        jitterRangeBonus = maxRangeBonus;
042                } else if (state == State.OUT) {
043                        jitterRangeBonus = jitterLevel * maxRangeBonus;
044                }
045                jitterLevel = (float) Math.sqrt(jitterLevel);
046                effectLevel *= effectLevel;
047                
048                ship.setJitter(this, JITTER_COLOR, jitterLevel, 3, 0, 0 + jitterRangeBonus);
049                ship.setJitterUnder(this, JITTER_UNDER_COLOR, jitterLevel, 25, 0f, 7f + jitterRangeBonus);
050                
051        
052                
053                float shipTimeMult = 1f + (stats.getDynamic().getValue(Stats.TEMPORAL_SHELL_MODIFIER, MAX_TIME_MULT) - 1f) * effectLevel;
054                stats.getTimeMult().modifyMult(id, shipTimeMult);
055                if (player) {
056                        Global.getCombatEngine().getTimeMult().modifyMult(id, 1f / shipTimeMult);
057//                      if (ship.areAnyEnemiesInRange()) {
058//                              Global.getCombatEngine().getTimeMult().modifyMult(id, 1f / shipTimeMult);
059//                      } else {
060//                              Global.getCombatEngine().getTimeMult().modifyMult(id, 2f / shipTimeMult);
061//                      }
062                } else {
063                        Global.getCombatEngine().getTimeMult().unmodify(id);
064                }
065                
066                ship.getEngineController().fadeToOtherColor(this, JITTER_COLOR, new Color(0,0,0,0), effectLevel, 0.5f);
067                ship.getEngineController().extendFlame(this, -0.25f, -0.25f, -0.25f);
068        }
069        
070        
071        public void unapply(MutableShipStatsAPI stats, String id) {
072                ShipAPI ship = null;
073                boolean player = false;
074                if (stats.getEntity() instanceof ShipAPI) {
075                        ship = (ShipAPI) stats.getEntity();
076                        player = ship == Global.getCombatEngine().getPlayerShip();
077                        id = id + "_" + ship.getId();
078                } else {
079                        return;
080                }
081
082                Global.getCombatEngine().getTimeMult().unmodify(id);
083                stats.getTimeMult().unmodify(id);
084                
085//              stats.getHullDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
086//              stats.getArmorDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
087//              stats.getEmpDamageTakenMult().unmodify(id);
088        }
089        
090        public StatusData getStatusData(int index, State state, float effectLevel) {
091                float shipTimeMult = 1f + (MAX_TIME_MULT - 1f) * effectLevel;
092                if (index == 0) {
093                        return new StatusData("time flow altered", false);
094                }
095//              if (index == ) {
096//                      return new StatusData("increased speed", false);
097//              }
098//              if (index == 1) {
099//                      return new StatusData("increased acceleration", false);
100//              }
101                return null;
102        }
103}
